content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional platforms fail creators in Ghana because they rely on centralized payment systems tied to specific regions. COREMERCH’s infrastructure removes this dependency by using decentralized tools. Cloudflare Pages hosts your store for free, while Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic without servers. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC. File delivery is handled through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring instant access for buyers. This stack is borderless—it operates independently of local banking systems or payment processors. You’re not renting space on someone else’s platform; you’re deploying your own. The architecture is designed to withstand the same financial isolation that COREMERCH was pressure-tested against in Zimbabwe. It’s not a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure that gives you full control and ownership.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying, gather your digital products and a clear plan for your store. You’ll need a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting and a NOWPayments account for crypto payment processing. Choose the cryptocurrencies you’ll accept—BSC, Solana, or TRON are recommended for low fees under $0.10 per transaction. Prepare your product files and descriptions. If you’re using the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you’ll have all blueprints and templates ready to deploy. Ensure your domain is configured, or use a free GitHub Pages URL. Familiarize yourself with the stack components: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. No coding experience is required, but understanding the flow of data and payments will help you troubleshoot effectively.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by setting up your payment gateway with NOWPayments. Create an account, select your preferred cryptocurrencies, and generate API keys. Integrate these keys into your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. For file delivery, upload your products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and generate shareable links. Configure your frontend on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to display products and initiate payments. When a buyer completes a transaction, NOWPayments sends a webhook to your backend, which verifies the payment and triggers file delivery. Test the entire pipeline with a small transaction to ensure all components work seamlessly. The Complete Builder Kit includes pre-built templates for this integration, saving you time and ensuring accuracy. Once deployed, your store operates automatically, with no manual intervention required for payment verification or product delivery.
Own your infrastructure—no platform can lock you out.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your store by pushing your code to GitHub or Cloudflare. Share your live URL with your audience. When a customer purchases a product, NOWPayments processes the payment on-chain and fires a webhook to your backend. Your backend verifies the payment, logs the order in Supabase or Google Sheets, and sends the buyer a secure download link. Monitor your first transactions closely to ensure all steps execute correctly. Use the order storage system to track sales and customer data. Since you own the infrastructure, there’s no platform to shut you down or freeze your funds. Your customers pay directly to your wallet, and you deliver products instantly. This system is designed to work in regions where traditional platforms fail, giving you a competitive edge in the global market.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your store is live, focus on scaling by adding more products and optimizing your pipeline. Use the analytics from Supabase or Google Sheets to track sales trends and customer behavior. Expand your accepted cryptocurrencies based on buyer preferences. If traffic increases, upgrade to Cloudflare’s paid tier for higher performance. The Complete Builder Kit includes a scaling playbook to guide you through these steps. Automate marketing by integrating email campaigns triggered by successful purchases. Since your infrastructure is sovereign, you can replicate the stack across multiple regions without additional costs. As your business grows, you’ll never hit platform limits or face geographic restrictions. This isn’t just a store—it’s a scalable commerce engine you own and control.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Gather your digital products and prepare descriptions. 2. Create accounts on GitHub/Cloudflare, NOWPayments, and Google Drive/Cloudflare R2. 3. Select cryptocurrencies (BSC, Solana, TRON recommended). 4. Configure your domain or use a free GitHub Pages URL. 5. Deploy your frontend on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 6. Set up backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 7. Integrate NOWPayments API keys for payment processing. 8. Upload products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and generate shareable links. 9. Test the pipeline with a small transaction. 10. Share your live store URL with your audience.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this infrastructure if I have no coding experience?

Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes pre-built templates and step-by-step guides. You don’t need to write code from scratch, but understanding the flow of data and payments will help you deploy and manage your store effectively.
What cryptocurrencies should I accept for low fees?
BSC, Solana, and TRON are recommended for transaction fees under $0.10. These networks are fast and cost-effective, making them ideal for digital product sales.
Do I need to pay recurring fees for this infrastructure?
No. After purchasing the Complete Builder Kit, you own the infrastructure. There are no subscriptions or recurring fees. The only cost is NOWPayments’ 0.5% transaction fee.
Can I scale this stack as my business grows?

Yes. The infrastructure is designed to scale. You can add more products, expand accepted cryptocurrencies, and upgrade Cloudflare’s performance tier as needed. The scaling playbook in the kit guides you through these steps.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?

NOWPayments operates independently of your stack. If it experiences downtime, payments will pause until it’s back online. Your store remains live, and you can switch to another payment processor if needed.
